name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: The goal of this role, taking administrative work off Operations leaders so they can focus on their departments, is something I understand from both sides. I run my own consulting practice, so I handle every scheduling, tracking, documentation, and follow-up task myself, and I know how much management time disappears into that work when nobody owns it.

I'm organized by habit. I document every interaction, deadline, and deliverable so nothing depends on memory. At Wix I kept up to 25 active client launches moving at once on fixed schedules, ran weekly training for teams of up to 30, and helped hire and onboard new team members. I write clear, plain-language documentation and training material, and I work well without close supervision.
Formal executive-assistant work and arranging travel would be new to me, and I learn systems fast. I'm available on ET hours and would welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
